title: Property Dealer Marketing Ideas: Low-Budget Ways to Get Enquiries
seoTitle: Property Dealer Marketing Ideas on a Small Budget
excerpt: Property dealer marketing ideas that cost time, not money: Google profile, WhatsApp, better portal listings, local tie-ups, referrals and a 30-day plan.

faqs.question: What are the best marketing ideas for a property dealer?
faqs.answer: The best low-budget ideas are a complete Google Business Profile with regular reviews, a WhatsApp Business catalogue and daily Status posts, a few high-quality portal listings, short phone videos of real properties, society and service-people tie-ups, and referrals from past clients. Add small, targeted Meta ads once these basics work well.

faqs.question: How can a small property dealer get more buyers without a big budget?
faqs.answer: Focus on what buyers check before calling: your Google profile, reviews, listing photos and WhatsApp reply speed. Ask every happy client for a review and a referral, post one real listing on WhatsApp Status daily, and reply to portal enquiries within minutes. These cost time, not money, and help every paid channel later.

faqs.question: How do property dealers get new listings from owners?
faqs.answer: Owners choose dealers they already know and trust locally. Build relationships with society managers, RWAs, electricians, painters, movers and guards who hear early when families plan to move. Share a one-page locality price and rent guide, keep neat boards with owner permission, and thank people who send you owners.

faqs.question: Is Google Business Profile useful for property dealers?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many buyers and owners search locally before calling a dealer. Use your real business name without added keywords, add photos, list your service areas, and reply to every review. Google lets service-area businesses hide their address and set up to 20 service areas by city, postal code or locality.

faqs.question: Can I send bulk WhatsApp messages to promote my listings?
faqs.answer: No, not to people who never opted in. WhatsApp's Business Messaging Policy says you may only contact people who gave you their number and agreed to receive messages. Bulk messages to bought lists can get your number restricted. Use Status updates and message only clients and enquirers who expect to hear from you.

faqs.question: Should a property dealer run Facebook and Instagram ads?
faqs.answer: Yes, but only after your Google profile, WhatsApp replies and listings are in good shape, because people check those after seeing an ad. Start with one small campaign for a specific property or locality, use a short lead form asking budget and timing, and track which ad brought each enquiry and deal.

faqs.question: Does a property dealer need RERA registration to market properties?
faqs.answer: Under Section 9 of the Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016, agents must register with their state RERA authority before acting for others in registered projects. Section 10 also bars facilitating sales in unregistered projects and making false statements. Check your state RERA website for local rules on showing registration numbers.

faqs.question: How do property dealers get referrals?
faqs.answer: Ask at the happiest moment, right after key handover or signing the rent agreement. Send a short WhatsApp thanking the client, asking for a Google review, and asking if anyone they know wants to buy, sell or rent. Stay in touch with useful updates, such as local rents, and thank every referrer properly.
